instructionIncludes: 每个 tab 下新增一个「下一页」按钮

output.summary: 每页加下一页按钮并校验切页

handlers.code: const f=this.getFormRef();const tab=f.getWidgetRef('wizardTab');if(!tab)return;const idx=tab.getActiveTabIndex();const pane=tab.widget.tabs[idx];const names=(pane.widgetList||[]).filter(function(w){return w.formItemFlag&&w.options&&w.options.required;}).map(function(w){return w.options.name;});var bad=null;for(var i=0;i<names.length;i++){var v=f.getFieldValue(names[i]);if(v===null||v===undefined||v===''){bad=names[i];break;}}if(bad){var w=f.getWidgetRef(bad);if(w&&w.focus)w.focus();return;}if(idx<tab.widget.tabs.length-1)tab.activeTab(idx+1);
handlers.explain: 必填为空则聚焦，否则下一页
